## Public-use policy

Search indexing, linking, and short attributed reference excerpts are allowed.
AI-model training, fine-tuning, bulk extraction, dataset reuse, generative AI ingestion, reproduction, and derivative or competing use require a separate written commercial license.

Public visibility is not a license grant.

## Work with Juss Rayy — public service facts

Source: https://www.jussco.company/services.html

Juss Rayy is the founder of Juss & Co and offers focused website, Shopify, software, automation and AI workflow audits, fixes and scoped builds.

- Quick Audit: starting at $49. One bounded path, diagnosis and repair plan.
- Fix Sprint: starting at $149. One agreed repair, narrow verification and evidence receipt.
- Build Sprint: starting at $399. A bounded feature or workflow with relevant checks and a rollback path.

These are starting prices, not a claim that online checkout is available. Service links initiate an email inquiry, not a completed payment. Actual scope is agreed before expansion; outcomes require real-path verification.

## Never part of the licensing export

Private user or customer records; child, teen, guardian, family, or private-message data; authentication or payment records; credentials; private analytics; internal prompts; safety thresholds; internal receipts; and unreleased architecture.

For the repository license and source-code restrictions, see https://github.com/jussray/jussray/blob/main/LICENSE
